item.title: THE SADO LIFE OF ROSE THE WITCH Manga Is Receiving A TV Anime Adaptation
item.description: Ominaeshi's reverse-isekai slice-of-life manga The Sado Life of Rosé the Witch is getting a TV anime. The series follows a fantasy witch adapting to life on Japan's Sado Island.

item.title: THE OBLIVIOUS SAINT CAN'T CONTAIN HER POWER Anime Reveals New Teaser And 2026 Premiere Date
item.description: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power anime drops its first teaser PV, teaser visual, main staff details, and confirms a 2026 debut.

item.title: Gift-o'-Animation Founder Satoshi Mori Passes Away At 41
item.description: Animation director Satoshi Mori, founder of Gift-o'-Animation and key figure in recent Cardfight!! Vanguard series, has died after his battle with a prolonged illness.

item.title: ONE PIECE Season 2’s First Two Episodes Headed To Theaters For Special Screenings
item.description: One Piece: Into the Grand Line is hitting the big screen with the first two episodes of Season 2 showing in select theaters across North America. Tickets go on sale this Thursday!

item.title: The Straw Hats Head To Loguetown In New ONE PIECE Season 2 Clip
item.description: An exclusive clip from One Piece Season 2 was shared this week, teasing the Straw Hat's journey to the Grand Line, which includes a quick shopping spree at Loguetown.

item.title: First Look At BLEACH: THOUSDAND-YEAR BLOOD WAR Funko Pop! Figures
item.description: New images of the upcoming line of Funko Pop! figures based on Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War have popped up online, ahead of pre-orders opening next week.

item.title: ONE PIECE Season 2 Prepares To Sail Into The Grand Line With Final Trailer Ahead Of Next Week's Premiere
item.description: Ahead of next week's premiere, Netflix has shared the final trailer for One Piece: Into the Grand Line. Season 2 is set to premiere on March 10th.

item.title: The Secret Of The ONE PIECE Is Now Buried At The Bottom Of The Ocean
item.description: One Piece creator Eiichiro Oda has finally written down the secret of the legendary treasure, but promptly buried it at the bottom of the ocean where it will remain until the story concludes.

item.title: ONE PIECE Season 2 Sneak Peek: Straw Hats Preview Grand Line Locations
item.description: With One Piece Season 2 right around the corner, the Straw Hats are giving fans a sneak peek at the new Grand Line locations they’ll explore, from Loguetown to Drum Island.

item.title: ONE PIECE Season 2 Release Schedule, Episode Lengths, And Titles Revealed
item.description: With just days until One Piece: Into the Grand Line premieres on Netflix, we now have the titles and runtimes for all eight episodes in Season 2 of the live-action series
